Messages.Author: jan willem wijsman
Messages.Body:
hello again,

sorry to bring this up again, but I'm still somewhat puzzled. Acting
vamp. A is blocked by vamp. B. Vamp. A. plays dawn ops., followed by
drawing out the beast in combat. The combat continues. Vamp A. strikes
with his hands, the damage is not prevented by vamp. B. What happens
first: the strike damage or the dotb damage? If vamp. B. received aggr.
damage, you still follow the resolution phases until the combat ends?
(strikes-strikeres.-damageprev.-additional strikes-strike
res.-damageprev.-end of round -end of combat?).
In other words, if vamp. B. receives aggr. damage, do you wait until he
also gets the dotb damage before he goes to torpor?

What if Vamp. B. plays rötschreck in combination with vamp. A's dotb and
dawn ops.? Does vamp. B. still get 1 aggr. damage, even if combat ended
'before damage is resolved' (rotschreck).

I hope I'm not asking stuff thats been answered before,
thanks a lot,

Jan Willem.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
jan willem wijsman wrote:
>
> hello again,
>
> sorry to bring this up again, but I'm still somewhat puzzled. Acting
> vamp. A is blocked by vamp. B. Vamp. A. plays dawn ops., followed by
> drawing out the beast in combat. The combat continues. Vamp A. strikes
> with his hands, the damage is not prevented by vamp. B. What happens
> first: the strike damage or the dotb damage? If vamp. B. received aggr.

Strike damage. DotB damage occurs at the end of the round.

> damage, you still follow the resolution phases until the combat ends?

Yes, except that combat (and the round) ends when one of the combatants
is no longer ready. When the round ends, DotB damage is applied.

> (strikes-strikeres.-damageprev.-additional strikes-strike
> res.-damageprev.-end of round -end of combat?).
> In other words, if vamp. B. receives aggr. damage, do you wait until he
> also gets the dotb damage before he goes to torpor?

The DotB damage is applied, yes.

> What if Vamp. B. plays rötschreck in combination with vamp. A's dotb and
> dawn ops.? Does vamp. B. still get 1 aggr. damage, even if combat ended
> 'before damage is resolved' (rotschreck).

Yes, since Rotschreck ends the combat (and therefore the round).
Rotschreck ends combat before any "strike resolution" damage
(ruling) - it doesn't protect from end-of-round damage.
